description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. The `ask` envelope is a PUBLISHED tool contract. AGSC-09-14a places `citations[]` as a sixth top-level member with `body` a string — never inside `body`, where `body` could never be exactly the fixed no-answer string — so two conforming engines cannot differ, and this vector pins it for a matching and a non-matching question: the AGSC-08-18 envelope — source, trust, license, type, body — with EXACTLY ONE added top-level member, `citations[]`, an array of item IRIs; `trust` fixed at `untrusted`; `body` the answer TEXT with the Content Use Terms line embedded in it; at least one item IRI cited for every answer; and, when nothing matches, `body` exactly `no answer in this memory` with an empty `citations[]`. Only the envelope shape and the fixed string are asserted — the wording of a matching answer is a responder's own and is deliberately unspecified, exactly as cli-0004 leaves a fault message unspecified.

arguments.question: what is the airspeed of an unladen swallow?
